Δ decreases strictly in v at fixed u; sharp centered five-coordinate cubic inequality Σ(p_i−1/5)³≤(3/sqrt(20))(u−1/5)^{3/2} follows two-level Lagrange multiplier optimization, even with some zero masses. One-heavy/four-equal vector q(t)=(1−4t,t,t,t,t) maximizes v for each u in [1/5,1], t∈[0,1/5]; its Δ=48t³(75t³+30t²−27t+4)≥0, with H(1/5)=2/5 and H decreasing. Independently recomputed polynomial factor and six-category Δ=−1439/810000; equality/degenerate Bernoullis and ≥6 full-support perturbations covered. Finite vector checks supplement global analytic optimization.
